summary: Gentle-step TreeStrap experiment on the n-tuple leaf (the successor of the alpha-1.0 run in which both search-actor arms fell below the warm start): per-arm step sizes in the stage driver, a --games-d4 option in the screen binary so a 2,048-game depth-3 screen shares one block with a 512-game depth-4 cohort, seed-aligned pairing in the analysis, the selection rule between two TreeStrap step sizes; the preregistered experiment with three fresh leases; ran the three warm-started arms, the freeze and the one-shot screen; wrote the analysis, the result record, the approach page section, the web figures and the log entry.
validationPerformed: cargo test --release (15 unit tests) after the screen binary change
gate --weights on each of the three new table files before the screen lease opened
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.

The step sizes 0.05 and 0.2 were chosen by the model from the first TreeStrap run's validation curves (the alpha-1.0 shock), not from a preregistered sweep; the owner had asked for the search-target direction to be pursued and for advice on whether it has run its course.
